name: 1v1.LOL
gameDescription: 1v1.LOL is a free Third-Person shooter that allows you to practice and train your in-game skills for fortnite, but in a more controlled environment.
publicDescription: 1v1.LOL is a fast build-and-shoot browser game where quick turns decide duels. A faster sensitivity around 18cm to 30cm per 360 helps you swing and edit at speed.

name: 7 Days to Die
gameDescription: 7 Days to Die is an open-world game that is a unique combination of first person shooter, survival horror, tower defense, and role-playing games. Play the definitive zombie survival sandbox RPG that came first. Navezgane awaits!
publicDescription: 7 Days to Die is a survival crafting game where aiming is rarely frantic. A comfortable medium around 25cm to 40cm per 360 covers both exploring and the odd horde night.

name: Aim Gods
gameDescription: Aim Gods is a competitive, aim trainer-style shooter from Finalmouse.
publicDescription: Aim Gods is an aim-training and arena game built around fast clicking. A quicker sensitivity around 18cm to 30cm per 360 suits its snappy targets, though it is best to mirror whatever your main game uses.

name: Aim Lab
publicDescription: Aim Lab is an aim trainer, so the sensitivity that matters is the one from the game you actually play. Match your main game cm/360 here so the practice carries across.

name: Aiming.Pro
gameDescription: Mouse sensitivity converter for Aiming.Pro. Professional-grade online aim training available at https://aiming.pro. Made by Data Scientists and game designers, Aiming.Pro improves your aim fast.
publicDescription: This is Aiming.Pro itself. Set it to the exact sensitivity from the game you want to improve at, somewhere in the 28cm to 43cm per 360 range our data links to the best aim, so your training transfers straight back.

name: Aimtastic
publicDescription: Aimtastic is a free aim trainer. Match the sensitivity from your main game so the reps transfer, and if you are drilling pure flicks a faster 18cm to 30cm per 360 is fine.

name: Apex Legends
gameDescription: Apex Legends is a free-to-play battle royale game developed by Respawn Entertainment and published by Electronic Arts. It was released on February 4, 2019. The gameplay of Apex fuses elements from a variety of video games, including Respawn's own Titanfall series, battle royale games, class-based shooters, and those with evolving narratives. Approximately sixty players are pitted against each other on an island in squads of three, with one player controlling where their squad lands
publicDescription: Apex Legends is a fast battle royale with heavy tracking and close, mobile fights. A medium sensitivity around 20cm to 35cm per 360 keeps you on strafing targets without losing control.

name: Arc Raiders
gameDescription: ARC Raiders is a multiplayer extraction adventure, set in a lethal future earth, ravaged by a mysterious mechanized threat known as ARC.
publicDescription: Arc Raiders is a tense extraction shooter where a clean first shot matters. A steadier sensitivity around 30cm to 45cm per 360 gives the precision its careful fights reward.

name: Arma 3
gameDescription: Experience true combat gameplay in a massive military sandbox. Deploying a wide variety of single- and multiplayer content, over 20 vehicles and 40 weapons, and limitless opportunities for content creation, this is the PC’s premier military game. Authentic, diverse, open - Arma 3 sends you to war.
publicDescription: Arma 3 is a military simulator built on deliberate, long-range engagements. A slower sensitivity around 35cm to 50cm per 360 gives the fine control its patient combat needs.

name: Battalion 1944
gameDescription: Battalion recaptures the core of classic competitive shooters & refines the ‘classic’ FPS feel for the next generation. Focusing on 5v5 infantry combat, where precise flick shots with your Kar98, covering fire with your Thompson and fluid movement are key to clutching every round for your team. The game was announced via a Kickstarter campaign on February 3, 2016. The game is set during World War II and runs on Unreal Engine 4
publicDescription: Battalion 1944 is a tactical, CS-style WWII shooter that rewards a precise standing shot. A lower sensitivity around 30cm to 45cm per 360 helps you land them.

gameDescription: BattleBit Remastered is a low-poly, massive multiplayer FPS, supporting 254 players per server. Battle on a near-fully destructible map with various vehicles!
publicDescription: BattleBit Remastered mixes ranged fights with close infantry scraps across large maps. A medium sensitivity around 25cm to 40cm per 360 balances both.

gameDescription: Battlefield V is a first-person shooter video game developed by EA DICE and published by Electronic Arts. Battlefield V is the sixteenth installment in the Battlefield series. publicDescription: The Battlefield games span huge maps and close objective fights alike. A medium sensitivity around 22cm to 38cm per 360 suits that mix.
notes: Battlefield 1, Battlefield Hardline and Battlefield 4 all use the same sensitivity

gameDescription: Black Squad is a free-to-play military first-person-shooter. Players can master their skills and show off their strategies with a wide range of game maps, modes, and weapons to choose from. Join thousands of FPS players worldwide in one of the most played games on Steam!
publicDescription: Black Squad is a fast, free tactical shooter in the Counter-Strike mould. A sensitivity around 25cm to 40cm per 360 keeps your aim precise without feeling sluggish.

gameDescription: Originally a modification for Half-Life, the rights to Counter-Strike, as well as the developers working on it, were acquired by Valve Corporation in 2000. As such, to players use a lower sensitivity for cs:GO than any other game, something in the 30-45cm range per 360 turn is normally recommended

name: CS:GO
gameDescription: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive is a multiplayer first-person shooter video game developed by Hidden Path Entertainment and Valve Corporation. CS: GO features new maps, characters, weapons, and game modes, and delivers updated versions of the classic CS content
publicDescription: CS:GO is the ultimate tactical shooter requiring precise aim above all else. You will often know where your enemy will (approximately) be so the need for fast turns is limited. publicDescription: Cyberpunk 2077 is a single-player RPG, so sensitivity comes down to comfort rather than competition. A medium around 25cm to 40cm per 360 keeps gunplay and driving tidy.

Will you team up with strangers and stay strong together? Or play as a lone wolf to avoid betrayal? This is DayZ – this is your story.
publicDescription: DayZ is a tense survival game where engagements are rare and deadly. A slower sensitivity around 30cm to 45cm per 360 steadies the careful shots it demands.

gameDescription: Deadlock is an upcoming action game developed by Valve that combines the hero shooter and MOBA genres.
publicDescription: Deadlock is Valve's hero shooter and MOBA hybrid, with tracking and ability aim across lanes. A medium sensitivity around 20cm to 35cm per 360 keeps you flexible.

name: Deep Rock Galactic
gameDescription: Deep Rock Galactic is a 1-4 player co-op FPS featuring badass space Dwarves, 100% destructible environments, procedurally-generated caves, and endless hordes of alien monsters.
publicDescription: Deep Rock Galactic is a co-op mining shooter against swarms, not players. A comfortable medium around 25cm to 40cm per 360 handles the chaos of a bug wave.

name: Delta Force
gameDescription: Play for free in operator-based extraction and full-scale combined arms warfare. Become elite Operators, customize an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons, and deploy into thrill-packed missions across multiple modes.

publicDescription: Diabotical is an arena shooter in the Quake tradition. A quicker sensitivity around 18cm to 30cm per 360 suits its fast movement and weapon switching.
notes: Yaw is 0.022 internally; mouse_accel_post_scale_x/y = yaw * 60 = 1.32 at default

name: Destiny 2
gameDescription: Destiny 2 is an online-only multiplayer first-person shooter video game developed by Bungie and published by Activision. It was released in September 2017. It is an open-world first-person shooter. Its gameplay focuses on updates to new campaign modes, multiplayer maps, weapons
publicDescription: Destiny 2 mixes PvE hordes with precise Crucible duels. A medium sensitivity around 20cm to 35cm per 360 covers both, leaning lower if you mostly play Trials.

name: Dying Light
gameDescription: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus epidemic. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and face hordes of the infected.

publicDescription: Echo Point Nova is a fast parkour-based shooter with verticality and momentum. A faster sensitivity around 18cm to 30cm per 360 suits its movement-heavy gameplay.
notes: yaw/pitch defaults to 250 (internal multiplier); Look Sensitivity accepts 6 decimals

gameDescription: Escape from Tarkov is a hardcore and realistic online first-person action RPG/Simulator with MMO features and a story-driven walkthrough
publicDescription: Escape from Tarkov punishes a sloppy first shot harder than almost any shooter. A steady sensitivity around 30cm to 45cm per 360 gives the control its lethal fights need.

gameDescription: Discover the dark secrets of a lawless island ruled by violence and take the fight to the enemy as you try to escape. You’ll need more than luck to escape alive!

gameDescription: Welcome to Hope County, Montana, home to a fanatical doomsday cult known as Eden’s Gate. Stand up to cult leader Joseph Seed & his siblings, the Heralds, to spark the fires of resistance & liberate the besieged community.

name: Far Cry Primal
gameDescription: The award-winning Far Cry franchise returns with its innovative open world gameplay, bringing together massive beasts, breathtaking environments, and unpredictable savage encounters.
publicDescription: Far Cry Primal is a single-player game built around the bow rather than guns. A medium around 25cm to 40cm per 360 gives steady aim for its ranged hunting.

name: Fortnite
gameDescription: Fortnite Battle Royale is a player-versus-player battle royale game for up to 100 players, allowing one to play alone, in a duo, or in a squad (usually consisting of three or four players). Developed by Epic Games, it was released in 2017
publicDescription: In Fortnite, as with most Battle Royale style games, we recommend a medium sensitivity to allow flexibility between close range combat requiring fast tracking and turns, and long range precision. Something in the 25-37cm per 360 turn range is normally recommended.

name: Garry's Mod
gameDescription: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.

publicDescription: Halo Infinite keeps the series longer time-to-kill, so steady tracking beats wild flicking. A medium sensitivity around 22cm to 38cm per 360 fits it well.

publicDescription: Hunt: Showdown is slow and lethal, where one accurate shot ends a fight. A steadier sensitivity around 30cm to 45cm per 360 gives the precision it rewards.

name: Overwatch

If you specialise with one hero you can adjust accordingly, but Overwatch really requires flexibility at the cost of specialism more than any other game.

name: Spectre Divide
gameDescription: Spectre Divide is the genre-evolving, competitive 3v3 tactical shooter driven by Duality. Use Duality to control two bodies in real-time, letting you defend two sites at once, cover your own cross, or even trade yourself. Master tactical gunplay and an arsenal of future tech to achieve infamy.
publicDescription: Spectre Divide is a tactical shooter with a precise, CS-like gunplay model. A lower sensitivity around 30cm to 45cm per 360 helps you land the standing shots it rewards.

name: Splitgate
gameDescription: Splitgate is a free-to-play, fast-paced multiplayer shooter that features player-controlled portals. This sci-fi shooter takes the FPS genre to a new dimension with its portal mechanics, delivering high-flying, multi-dimensional combat.
publicDescription: Splitgate is a fast arena shooter with portals and constant repositioning. A quicker sensitivity around 18cm to 30cm per 360 helps you track through the movement.

name: Splitgate 2
gameDescription: Splitgate 2 is the only free-to-play shooter with portals, delivering next-level gunplay, fluid movement, and a constantly evolving experience, featuring a new Battle Royale where you can portal between unique worlds. Welcome to the future of sport.
publicDescription: Splitgate 2 keeps the portal-driven, fast arena combat of the original. A faster sensitivity around 18cm to 30cm per 360 keeps you on target through all the movement.

name: Squad
gameDescription: Squad is a tactical FPS that provides authentic combat experiences through teamwork, constant communication, and gameplay. It bridges the large gap between arcade shooter and military simulation with 100 player battles, combined arms combat, base building, and a great integrated VoIP system.
publicDescription: Squad is a large-scale tactical shooter built on teamwork and careful, ranged fights. A steadier sensitivity around 30cm to 45cm per 360 suits its deliberate pace.

name: Team Fortress 2
gameDescription: Team Fortress 2 is a team-based multiplayer first-person shooter video game developed and published by Valve Corporation. It is the sequel to the 1996 mod Team Fortress for Quake and its 1999 remake, Team Fortress Classic
publicDescription: Team Fortress 2 spans hitscan snipers and close projectile classes, so needs vary by who you main. A medium sensitivity around 22cm to 38cm per 360 is a solid all-round base.

name: THE FINALS
gameDescription: Join THE FINALS, the world-famous, free-to-play, combat-centered game show! Fight alongside your teammates in virtual arenas that you can alter, exploit, and even destroy. Build your own playstyle in this first-person shooter to win escalating tournaments and lasting fame.
publicDescription: THE FINALS is fast and chaotic, with destructible arenas and constant movement. A slightly faster sensitivity around 20cm to 33cm per 360 keeps you on moving targets.

name: Titanfall 2
gameDescription: Titanfall 2 is a first-person shooter video game, developed by Respawn Entertainment and published by Electronic Arts. A sequel to 2014's Titanfall, the game was released worldwide on October 28, 2016.  Featuring the debut of a singleplayer campaign and a deeper multiplayer experience
publicDescription: Titanfall 2 is built on speed, wall-running and quick fights. A faster sensitivity around 18cm to 30cm per 360 lets you track targets through all that movement.
notes: Titanfall 1 and 2 use the same sensitivity

name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow 6: Siege
gameDescription: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege (also known as R6) is a tactical shooter video game developed by Ubisoft Montreal and published by Ubisoft. It was released on December 1, 2015. The game puts heavy emphasis on environmental destruction and cooperation between players.
publicDescription: As R6 Siege is a slow tactical shooter in the style of CS:GO, most top players opt for a sensitivity between 26cm-45cm to complete a 360 turn. Having your sensitivity too much higher than this will impact your ability to turn quickly, and lower than this will reduce your aiming precision, particularly at longer ranges, not ideal for rainbow 6!

name: Tom Clancy's The Division 2
gameDescription: Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is an online action role-playing video game developed by Massive Entertainment and published by Ubisoft. Seven months have passed since a deadly virus hit New York City. The Division 2 is a true RPG that offers more variety in missions and challenges, a new end-game, and fresh innovations to engage players
publicDescription: The Division 2 is a cover-based looter shooter, more methodical than twitchy. A medium sensitivity around 25cm to 40cm per 360 suits its measured fights.
notes:
Tom Clancy's The Division 1 uses the same sensitivity

Approximate conversion values

name: Unturned
gameDescription: You're a survivor in the zombie infested ruins of society, and must work with your friends and forge alliances to remain among the living.
publicDescription: Unturned is a blocky survival shooter where aiming is rarely frantic. A comfortable medium around 25cm to 40cm per 360 covers its mix of exploring and combat.

name: Valheim
gameDescription: A brutal exploration and survival game for 1-10 players, set in a procedurally-generated purgatory inspired by viking culture. Battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage
publicDescription: Valheim is a survival game where ranged combat leans on the bow. A comfortable medium around 25cm to 40cm per 360 gives steady aim for hunting and raids.

name: Valorant
gameDescription: Valorant is a  free-to-play multiplayer first-person shooter video game developed by Riot Games. A tactical 5v5 character-based shooter set in a near-future version of Earth. Some people describe Valorant as the perfect coming together of CS:GO and Overwatch.
publicDescription: As Valorant is a slow-paced, tactical shooter we recommend a slightly lower sensitivity. Something in the 25cm-45cm per 360 turn would be ideal. A lower sensitivity gives you more precision with your aiming. It comes at the cost of faster turns, but in a game like Valorant, that is less relevant

name: Warface
gameDescription: Warface is a free-to-play online first-person shooter developed by Crytek Kiev and co-produced by Crytek Seoul.  5 player Co-op, new daily content, PVP and intense tactical combat powered by CRYENGINE
publicDescription: Warface is a free, fast modern shooter in the Call of Duty style. A medium sensitivity around 22cm to 38cm per 360 keeps you quick without overshooting.

name: Warframe
gameDescription: Warframe is a cooperative free-to-play third person online action game set in an evolving sci-fi world
publicDescription: Warframe is a fast co-op shooter where you carve through enemies rather than duel players. A medium sensitivity around 22cm to 38cm per 360 keeps aiming snappy through the swarm.

name: XDefiant
gameDescription: XDefiant is a free-to-play first-person shooter video game developed by Ubisoft San Francisco and published by Ubisoft.
publicDescription: XDefiant is a fast, arena-style shooter with quick time-to-kill. A medium sensitivity around 22cm to 38cm per 360 lets you react quickly without losing precision.

name: Xonotic
gameDescription: Xonotic is an addictive arena-style first person shooter with crisp movement and a wide array of weapons. It combines intuitive mechanics with in-your-face action to elevate your heart rate.
publicDescription: Xonotic is an open-source arena shooter in the Quake tradition, fast and movement-driven. A quicker sensitivity around 18cm to 28cm per 360 fits its speed.

name: Zula
gameDescription: Zula is a first person shooter. You will totally immerse yourself in the world of Zula thanks to very realistic graphics. The game has various game modes as for example Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Free for All or Wanted. Sixteen playable characters, inspired by popular TV heroes
publicDescription: Zula is a free tactical shooter with fast, close-quarters gunfights. A medium sensitivity around 25cm to 40cm per 360 keeps your aim precise.
